newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - GModelo raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GModelo raised to buy.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Interacciones said it raised its recommendation on Mexican beer maker Grupo Modelo to buy from hold, according to a statement on Monday.
Analyst Greg Rianhard said the upgrade was due mainly to Modelo underperforming the market, and a moderate increase in Interacciones' price target for the company for by year end.
He said that Modelo's stock should outperform that of competitor Femsa.
He forecast a year-end share price of 59 pesos for Modelo, with earnings per share seen at 1.55 pesos for 1997.
Modelo's shares stood at 51.60 pesos at midday Monday, down 20 centavos from Friday's close.
((-- Toms de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-7912))
